subject: [PATCH] memcg: move LRU size accounting on reparenting instead of copying it

2026-08-24.patch_summary: This patch moves the accounting of LRU size on reparenting instead of copying it, which fixes a problem where stale values were left in child memory cgroups after they were offlined and their folios were reparented to the parent. This issue caused unnecessary work for the vmscan scanner and led to over-budgeting of shadow node limits under MGLRU. The patch updates the lruvec_reparent_lru() function to clear the child's LRU size counter instead of copying it, which ensures that the parent is credited with exactly the folios it took over.
